title: Tracking a novel loader: PIPEDANCE
description: An analysis of the PIPEDANCE loader observed in recent intrusions.
body: Key takeaways PIPEDANCE is a novel loader used to stage secondary payloads. It uses process injection to evade detection. Analysis The loader begins by resolving kernel32.dll exports via a custom PEB walk. API resolution Once resolved, the loader calls VirtualAlloc to stage the payload in memory.
summary: An analysis of the PIPEDANCE loader observed in recent intrusions.
